summary: Test pyramid is well-balanced across the 6 Python suites (unit-heavy with appropriate integration), Molecule scenarios cover all 11 Ansible roles with idempotency checks, and CI workflows (e2e-smoke, smoke-gate) wire together end-to-end. 38 of 42 user-spec ACs are traced to automated tests; 3 are documented manual steps (bootstrap-checklist); 1 (AC42 backup test-restore) is correctly documented as manual per task 22 edge-case note. Remediation items: (a) hung_tmux check has no direct happy/sad-path unit test (only an indirect scheduler reference); (b) no automated test for AC25–AC28 per-topic feature toggles (delegated to ruflo Molecule role verify; not asserted programmatically end-to-end); (c) byte-equivalence + WASM harnesses rely on stub fixtures and skip when serializers aren't built — no fail-on-missing assertion, which weakens AC17/AC20 enforcement; (d) Mnemonic attestation lineage (AC11–AC16) is only exercised by the e2e-smoke workflow DAG-poll step — no isolated unit test of the hook→MCP signing path. None of these are blocking but each warrants either an added test, a documented manual-verify step, or AVP coverage in T25.

integrations-swarm-bridge.notes: Covers happy/sad paths: dispatch, capacity 409 retry once, 5xx exhaustion, swarm_init failure (SwarmError), partial-spawn failure (RufloSpawnError with context), worktree leak detection, multi-wave sequencing, asyncio.CancelledError propagation during retry sleep, concurrent features without cwd collision, auto_cleanup vs explicit-cleanup contract. Mocking is appropriate (3rd-party MCP boundary). One gap: no test exercises an HTTP 5xx-then-success retry path against a real WorkspaceClient (only against the simulated WorkspaceClientError); retry logic on WorkspaceClient itself is implicitly trusted.

molyanov-validators.notes: _common.py (47 tests): ANSI/control-char sanitisation, severity normalisation incl. unknown→'error' (security-critical default), canonical-vs-alias field priority, invoke_ruflo argv construction + option-injection rejection + timeout cap + shell=False. Three plugin wrappers each cover: target/profile/scenario forwarding, golden output normalisation, missing-binary error result, timeout result, dry_run gate, extra_args injection blocking. post-deploy-qa adds SSRF guard (localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]/RFC1918 rejected). Excellent coverage; no findings.

watchdog.notes: Covers 9 of 10 alert classes with direct happy+sad path: orphaned_worktrees (4), disk_pressure (3 incl. 75/85/90 thresholds), solana_rpc (3 incl. unhealthy result + unreachable), master_drift (3), failed_attestation (3), stale_swarms (4), stale_lkg (4), irys_balance (5), stale_prs (4 pagination + parse_next_link). Security-class extras: SSRF allowlist (8), disabled-checks acknowledgement guard (3), token scrubbing (2), state-file mode 0640 (2), alert_class binding (5), deterministic alert_id (4), rate-limit (1). GAP: hung_tmux check has NO direct unit test for its detection logic — only an indirect reference at test_checks.py:800 where the check is disabled. Recommend adding a TestHungTmux class with at least: tmux not installed → None; sessions present but fresh → None; one session idle > threshold → Alert with WARNING severity.

harnesses.notes: byte-equivalence (6): stub fixtures + Rust↔TS hash equality; tests use pytest.skip when binaries aren't built — this means CI passes with zero real comparisons until protocol repos provide compiled serializers. Recommend: add a test that fails when both serializers are unbuilt AND env var REQUIRE_SERIALIZERS=true (CI flag). mcp-compat (8): initialize/list_resources/read_resource against StubMCPClient + golden trace JSONL validation + mutation detection + round-trip consistency. full-mode (8): stub fixtures + sign/submit/confirm/upload/finalize/retrieve happy paths + independent_verifier subprocess + mutation detection. wasm-browser (5 Playwright specs): WASM load + serializer output + round-trip + fixture mutation + perf threshold. All four harnesses scaffold correctly per tech-spec note (real fixtures follow protocol-repo availability). Test mutation posture: present in 3 of 4 (byte-eq, mcp-compat, full-mode). Acceptable for scaffolding wave but track 'unbuilt serializer skip' as a known coverage gap to close once mnemonic-core/wasm fixtures land.

ansible-molecule.notes: 11 Molecule scenarios with verify.yml: base (hostname, op user, code dir 0750, .fabric dirs, ufw active, sshd PermitRootLogin/PasswordAuthentication off, unattended-upgrades installed). tailscale (package, service, repo, keyring, tailscale_ip fact). vaultwarden (compose, Caddyfile, .env 0600, data 0700, docker containers, no 0.0.0.0 bind, admin token present, idempotency include_role). kaneo (health endpoint, container, dirs, idempotent project count). telegram-init (telegram-topics.yml with 8 canonical topics, thread IDs > 0). restic-backups (binary, /etc/restic 0700, repo.env 0600, backup-verify.sh executable, systemd timer enabled). ruflo (global.yml, 8 topic configs, validate_matrix.py runs). molyanov (skills bundle, pk-guard.sh 0755, ops-notify.sh 0755, ruflo hooks.d integration, RUFLO_SESSION negative test). mnemonic-mcp (binary, config.yml, 5 hooks executable+owned, systemd unit, molyanov-mnemonic-hooks.yml). telegram-ai-agent (uv, /opt repo, .venv, config.yml, .env 0600, systemd enabled, 'cwd: DYNAMIC' x8 in config, env vars). ssh-hardening: no molecule scenario (compensated by base role sshd assertions). Idempotency: explicitly tested via include_role re-apply in vaultwarden + kaneo + molyanov; relied-upon Ansible idempotency in the rest.

safe-mode-bash.notes: fabric/safe-mode/tests/test_lkg.sh covers: advance on non-loop branch (sha match), skip on mnemonic-loop branch (sha unchanged), idempotency (re-run = same sha), replace-stale-tag, skip when MNEMONIC_TASK_BRANCH unset. ci-workflows.notes: e2e-smoke.yml: tailscale ephemeral up → ping VM → scp smoke.sh → run on VM → poll mnemonic_recall for 5-node DAG (max 20 min) → jq-assert parent chain + types (memory/memory/receipt/receipt/agent-state) → verify worktree count ≤ 10 → sign attestation → commit comment / Telegram ops on failure with sanitised diagnostic. DAG validation is comprehensive (length=5, fields, feature match, parent chain, types). smoke-gate.yml: PR trigger + path filter + 15-min budget + docker-compose candidate fabric + health poll + run.sh + /tmp/smoke-task-complete check + log redaction + Telegram failure post. Both workflows have appropriate timeouts and failure paths.

brittleness_review.time_dependent_assertions: scheduler timeout test patches _PER_CHECK_TIMEOUT to 1s and allows 3x jitter — acceptable; stale_lkg uses real GIT_AUTHOR_DATE backdating — robust; rate-limit test allows 5ms tolerance — acceptable. No raw sleep-then-assert anti-patterns.
brittleness_review.network_without_mocks: test_solana_rpc_unreachable_endpoint hits 127.0.0.1:19999 (intentionally unreachable, deterministic); test_failed_attestation_mcp_unreachable hits 127.0.0.1:19998. Both fine — no real network. WASM browser test goes to about:blank via Playwright local server.
brittleness_review.isolation: All tests use pytest tmp_path / multiprocessing.Queue / mock.patch — no shared global state. Sanitizer logging tests carefully set propagate=False on test loggers. Ansible Molecule containers are per-scenario.
brittleness_review.flake_risk: Low. The only mild concern is the multiprocessing concurrency test (test_concurrent_add_same_task_id) which has a 10-second timeout — acceptable buffer on CI. The Playwright WASM perf test uses a 5ms-per-iteration threshold which could flake under contended runners; recommend bumping to 10ms or marking as informational.

production_like_behavior.mocks_match_real_contracts: workspace-manager fake_run mock for git mirrors real `git worktree add/remove` argv structure incl. `--detach --` separator and directory creation side effect — high fidelity. RufloClient / WorkspaceClient mocks use spec= so signature drift is caught. ruflo subprocess calls are mocked at subprocess.run boundary, not at higher abstractions. Vault uses bw-cli mock returning realistic 'notes' JSON.
production_like_behavior.concerns: swarm-bridge mocks don't exercise the real WorkspaceClient.create_worktree HTTP retry chain — only the mock raises capacity/5xx errors. Acceptable because workspace-manager itself has its own retry-free contract; the bridge consumes typed exceptions. Documented for traceability.

overall_remediation_plan: 1. Add TestHungTmux (3 tests) to close AC30 last gap — 15 min effort, blocks no other work.

2. Add REQUIRE_SERIALIZERS=true CI env switch to byte-equivalence + wasm-browser harnesses so skipped tests fail when binaries are expected — 30 min effort. Until upstream protocol repos publish artefacts, classify AC17/AC20 enforcement as 'scaffolding + PR-template gate'.
3. T25 AVP must include explicit ops-topic-independence drill (stop ws-mgr/ruflo/watchdog → /ping ops bot → assert reply) for AC3 closure.
4. T25 AVP must include explicit deliberate-break drill for AC37 closure (corrupt state.json → safe-mode-rollback → verify restoration).
5. (Optional) Add behavioural Molecule test for 5 mnemonic-mcp hook scripts (mock mnemonic-cli + assert attestation type/parent) to harden AC11–AC16 beyond e2e-only coverage.
6. (Optional) Add 32-byte private key + AWS-style access key patterns to sanitizer corpus for defensive widening (AC40).
